wx_version_desc: 登录微信头像上传修复
root_causes: syncAvatarInBackground was fire-and-forget; login sheet hid/navigated before wx.uploadFile completed; WeChat http://tmp/wxfile temp paths expired → client fail with zero MiniProgramEnv hits to /api/v1/mp/upload in nginx (14d)
toast conflated profile writeback failure with upload failure
upload() only read AuthUtil storage token; no early 401 when token missing
backend rejected MultipartFile without filename extension (chooseAvatar edge case)
fixes: persistLocalFileForUpload to USER_DATA_PATH on chooseAvatar + before upload
await token + await avatar sync (12s timeout) inside runOneTapLogin before UI success
accurate toasts: 网络/鉴权/资料同步
upload() prefer app.globalData.token; auth=true rejects without token
backend_status: source + jar rebuild required for extension fallback
